授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
機能的に多様な微生物集団（複合微生物系）を利用する為に必要な好適制御を如何にして行なうのか、どの様な視点や考え方が必要になるのか、について実際の研究事例を紐解きながら考察する。
授業の概要：
微生物細胞が生存する為のエネルギー獲得機構、酵素反応および細胞の増殖に関して基礎的な解説を行なう。次に、微生物を利用した効率的な汚染環境の浄化に関する研究事例を出発点に、機能的に多様な微生物集団である微生物生態系を好適に制御する為の考え方について、既知の方法・限界・今後の課題に触れながら、解説する。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Basic explanations are given on the energy acquisition mechanism, enzyme reaction, and cell growth for microbial cells to survive. Next, taking the example of efficient purification of contaminated environment using microorganisms as an example, there are known methods, their limitations, and future issues regarding the concept of controlling microbial ecosystems that are functionally diverse microbial populations. Explain about.

授業科目の実施方法について.備考:
Toward the Utilization and Understanding of Complex Microbial Systems
Hiroyuki Futamata (Professor, Research Institute of Green Science and Technology, Shizuoka University)
Course Overview: *Lectures will be conducted in Japanese. Some lecture materials will be provided in English.
This course first provides fundamental explanations of energy acquisition mechanisms for microbial cell survival, enzymatic reactions, and cell growth. It then introduces efficient remediation of contaminated environments using microorganisms as a case study. Based on this example, the course discusses concepts for the optimal control of functionally diverse microbial communities (microbial ecosystems), including existing approaches, their limitations, and future challenges.
Course Format: Lectures and report assignments
